systems.system: digitalization of land records (Catalysing Durable Solutions programme)
systems.owner: IOM, funded by the European Union, in partnership with national, state and county authorities
systems.tiers: Rubkona County (Unity State) and Yei River County (Central Equatoria State), with national-level support; planned, implementation from 1 January 2026 for 30 months

note: A commitment to digitise land records in two counties (class application); no connection of any local government office is stated.
